leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a reactive online status state using Vue's ref API
Implement event listeners for online and offline browser events
Construct a composable function that returns the current network status
Bind the online status to conditionally render UI elements
Integrate the useOnlineStatus composable into a Vue component
Manipulate the component's behavior based on network connectivity changes
Configure cleanup logic to remove event listeners when the component unmounts
